report.value: Route 1: ISO7741DWR (barrier) with LTM8068EY#PBF (both pack-side rails), 1.4745 + 25.4643 = 26.94 at the 1 break, plus a preload resistor of about 10 mA at 18 V. Route 2: ISOW7741BDFMR (barrier and 5 V rail) with TPS61040DBVR (V+), 7.969 + 0.7479 = 8.72 at the 1 break, plus a boost inductor and Schottky diode not selected. Both routes need the V+ OR element. Prices carry no currency in the JLCPCB API

ISO7741DWR at VCC2 = 5 V: ICC2 at most 6.4 mA at 10 Mbps (bounds the 2 Mbps of a 1 MHz SPI clock), 4.6 mA at 1 Mbps; DC 3.7 mA (inputs high) to 5.2 mA (inputs low). ISO6741DWR: 6.5 / 4.5 mA, DC 5.1 mA. ISOW7741BDFMR IISOIN: 8.9 / 7.1 mA, DC 7.9 mA
Awake: ADBMS1818 VREG 16.5 mA (measure) + 8.1 mA (ISOMD = V-, active, RB1 + RB2 = 2 kOhm; 3.3 mA with 20 kOhm) + ISO7741 6.4 mA = 31.0 mA at most. Asleep: VREG 9 uA + ISO7741 3.7 to 5.2 mA
IVP at most 1.4 mA (measure), 0.825 mA (REFUP), 28 uA (standby), 9 uA (sleep with VREG = 5 V), full temperature range

Minimum load about 15 mA at VOUT1 18 V (typical graph, over the full input range). Asleep the module carries about 5.2 mA, so about 10 mA of preload (1.8 kOhm, 0.18 W at 18 V) keeps VOUT1 in regulation. Maximum load at VOUT1 18 V from VIN 5 V about 80 mA (typical graph) against 32.4 mA awake

report.figure: V+ feed from the highest tap
report.value: TME needs V+ at or above C18 - 0.3 V, and C18 may not exceed V+ + 5.5 V (absolute). With unused inputs tied to the top cell, C18 is the pack top. A fixed 18 V supply alone (17.7 V after a 0.3 V OR drop) misses TME for packs above 18.0 V (5 cells at 4.2 V, 21.0 V) and exceeds the absolute limit above 23.2 V (6 cells at 4.2 V, 25.2 V). V+ must also be fed from the highest connected tap; with no count setting (V193) that tap moves from C1 to C16, so the feed takes an OR element from each tap that can be a pack top, or another circuit. No function names it. A gap for P5 and P6
report.source: ADBMS1818 Rev. B Tables 3 and 11, p. 86; V193; F15
